topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Hearken, friend, the news I bear is hard, as hard as the stones that lie hid in our fields, biding their time to break a plow. Your friend, they say, is to venture far, over the hills and beyond, to a place distant and strange. The talk of the village buzzes like the bees in summer, but these are no sweet whispers. The soil will be heavy in your hands, and the sky might seem a touch too blue, a stark contrast to the shadow that hangs over the heart. May the saints keep your spirits as bright as the harvest moon, for the days to come will test the strength of the seeds sown in friendship. Pray, let us hope that the wind carries messages back and forth, as surely as it brings the rain.
